strict_subpanel_rule: historical uint64(first8 SHA256(seed|geneId)) mod 10 < 7, universe restricted to ordered G_S only
normalization: log1p(10000 * own-lane count / sum(own-lane counts)); zero library -> zero row
primary_precision: normalized hash stored float32 then unit float64 for geometry; perturbation lanes float64
forbidden_construction_inputs: G_R gene identities except independent final audit
poison_test: deterministic nonnegative pseudorandom G_R CSR source with unchanged G_S; rerun actual construction with allowlisted file opens; compare every lane/L/U/F/O numeric-array content digest
references: fresh independently seeded direct IID draws; no switch chain; fixed B; no early stopping; simplicity rejection discards proposal
pca: reuse only byte-verified G_S-only isolated PCA32/PCA64 and G_R-only target PCA32; replay matching on q25; single-lane q50 construction controls
mnn_fixed_size: nearest MNN subset with exactly strict native fiber cardinality, only where MNN degree >= native size; report coverage, no tuning
primary_success: each of edge/coherence/fidelity: all three relative reductions > 0 AND T_sum tail <= .05 AND T_min tail <= .05; component maxT separate
terminal_classification: A survives under frozen primary-success criteria; B qualifying survival with measured magnitude attenuation; C only some successes; D none. No magnitude threshold or lane optimization. Report family vs component support separately.
retention: only nonreproduction by tested R0-R3 if supported; no structural necessity
new_publication_primary: strict G_S-only 7-of-9 geometry; Referee04 demoted to isolated historical-lane sensitivity
